regime_context: Policy regime is a sequenced low-real-yield engineering campaign: the Fed (Warsh) is banking anti-inflation credibility now — a hawkish hold with no forward guidance — while the Treasury (Bessent) suppresses duration via bill-heavy issuance and dealer-structure reform. The consensus 'Fed must ease on labor weakness' narrative reads too calendar-driven; revealed interest is to keep the hike-majority posture intact as optionality cover for a post-midterm, inflation-gated pivot, even as the Iran oil shock makes that trade stagflationary and fragile.
regime_context_zh: 政策格局是一场按序推进的低实际利率工程：美联储（沃什）现在先积累反通胀信誉——鹰派按兵不动、不给前瞻指引——而财政部（贝森特）通过短债为主的发行和交易商结构改革压低久期利率。市场共识的“就业走弱美联储就必须转向宽松”叙事过于依赖日历节奏；更符合利益偏好的是维持加息占多数的姿态，作为中期选举后、以通胀为门槛转向宽松的期权式掩护，尽管伊朗油价冲击使这笔交易带有滞胀属性且十分脆弱。

theses.subject: XLE
theses.thesis: The Iran ceasefire collapse and US strikes (7/8–11) re-open the upside oil shock; the Bush-era capital rotation into energy on conflict headlines is re-primed. Bessent's strong-dollar bridge and the administration's need to manufacture demand for front-end issuance both tolerate an oil bid while the Fed stays hawkish — energy is the cleanest realpolitik expression of the re-escalation theater.
theses.thesis_zh: 伊朗停火破裂与美国打击（7月8–11日）重新打开油价上行冲击；冲突头条下资金轮动至能源的路径被再次激活。贝森特的强势美元桥梁，以及政府为前端发行制造需求的需要，都容忍油价走强，而美联储维持鹰派姿态——能源是再升级战线上最直接的地缘政治表达。
evidence: Theater: Iran / Middle East — ceasefire COLLAPSED (as of 7/8), Brent spiked ~$80 intraday
Theater: Iran — energy was top ETF-inflow sector Q1 2026 on the conflict
Rotation theme: Energy (oil & gas), proxies XLE/XOP — FACT mechanism (headline-fragile)
Track record: XLE overweight hits on 2026-09-04 (+0.056) and 2026-09-12 (+0.070)
theses.dissent: Oil is headline-fragile and the regime intent is explicitly LOW real yields and LOW inflation optics; a quick de-escalation or Hormuz normalization crushes the premium, and the record shows directional accuracy near coin-flip.
theses.dissent_zh: 油价对头条高度敏感，而这一政治格局的目标恰恰是低实际利率和低通胀观感；迅速降级或霍尔木兹局势正常化会立刻抹掉溢价，而且历史记录显示方向准确率接近抛硬币水平。

falsifier.text_zh: XLE 在检查日前跑输 SPY 5%

theses.subject: TLT
theses.thesis: The August-September regime called TLT avoid/underweight and scored hits; nothing in the substrate flips that. Warsh is withholding forward guidance and the market prices >70% probability of a September hike after hot PCE; duration is the wrong side while the Fed banks credibility and Bessent's yield suppression is a front-end, not long-end, lever.
theses.thesis_zh: 8月至9月的格局曾把 TLT 定为回避/低配并命中；本情报中没有内容改变这一点。沃什扣住前瞻指引，且偏热的 PCE 之后市场对9月加息的概率定价超过70%；在美联储积累信誉、贝森特的收益率抑制只是前端而非长端工具的阶段，久期是错误的一边。
evidence: Market: CME FedWatch >70% probability of a Sept hike (50.6% 25bp + 19.6% 50bp)
Theater: Dollar/debt — real policy reinforces front-end Treasuries, not long duration
Track record: TLT avoid hit 2026-09-04 (+0.013); TLT underweight hit 2026-09-12 (+0.012)
theses.dissent: A labor crack (June payrolls +57k, participation 61.5%) is the one catalyst the frame flags as able to reopen easing; if Warsh pivots data-dovish, long duration reprices violently.
theses.dissent_zh: 就业裂缝（6月非农+5.7万、参与率61.5%）正是该框架中唯一能重新打开宽松路径的催化剂；若沃什转向数据驱动偏鸽，长久期会剧烈重估。

falsifier.text: TLT outperforms SPY by 5% before the check-by date
falsifier.text_zh: TLT 在检查日前跑赢 SPY 5%

theses.subject: UUP
theses.thesis: The administration's stated preference is a strong dollar while cutting, and the Iran conflict feeds a haven bid that already took DXY to a 13-month high before the pullback. The front-end is not being cut into September; a hike-majority Fed plus haven flows keep real-dollar support intact relative to an easing-priced market.
theses.thesis_zh: 政府的公开偏好是在降息时维持强势美元，而伊朗冲突带来的避险买盘已经把美元指数推到13个月高点，只是随后有所回落。前端在9月前不会降息；加息占多数的美联储叠加避险资金流，使美元相对一个已定价宽松的市场保持实际支撑。
evidence: Thesis: Bessent's 6/24 'strong dollar while cutting' is the FX bridge
Theater: Dollar/debt — real policy vs Mar-a-Lago theory (front-end + strong dollar)
Market: DXY ~100.9 well off its 13-mo high, hike-majority CME path
Theater: Iran — haven bid on re-escalation
theses.dissent: A genuine Mar-a-Lago Accord turn (tail, not base case) would be explicitly dollar-bearish; also a post-midterm dovish pivot would undercut UUP, and a quick ceasefire would remove the haven bid.
theses.dissent_zh: 真正的海湖庄园协议转向（尾部而非基准情形）会明确利空美元；中期选举后的鸽派转向也会削弱 UUP，而快速停火会拿掉避险买盘。

falsifier.text: UUP lags SPY by 3% before the check-by date
falsifier.text_zh: UUP 在检查日前跑输 SPY 3%

theses.subject: OKLO
theses.thesis: Nuclear-for-AI is a real industrial-policy lever, but the desk's OKLO thesis has missed twice in the scored record (−0.53 and −0.62) and the open prediction on HALEU release is not yet confirmed. Without a contracted or sited reactor program, the named-proxy is a sentiment beta, not an accountable policy position.
theses.thesis_zh: AI 用核能是真实的产业政策杠杆，但研究台对 OKLO 的论点在已评分记录中两次落空（−0.53 和 −0.62），而且 HALEU 释放的开放预测尚未落地。在还没有签约或选址反应堆项目的情况下，具名代理只是情绪贝塔，不是可问责的政策头寸。
evidence: Rotation theme: Nuclear · uranium · HALEU/fuel cycle — OKLO listed as proxy
Open prediction: DOE releases ≥20 MT HALEU into the fuel bank (unconfirmed as of intel)
Open prediction: AI/critical-infrastructure reactor program shows contracted/sited project (unconfirmed)
Track record: OKLO overweight miss 2026-08-09 (−0.535), miss 2026-07-02 (−0.617)
theses.dissent: A sudden DOE HALEU release or a contracted AI reactor project would be a policy catalyst that the market has not fully priced into OKLO; missing it means giving up the industrial-policy core.
theses.dissent_zh: DOE 突然释放 HALEU 或 AI 反应堆项目签约，会是一个市场尚未对 OKLO 完全定价的政策催化剂；错过它等于放弃产业政策的核心标的。

falsifier.text: OKLO outperforms SPY by 10% before the check-by date
falsifier.text_zh: OKLO 在检查日前跑赢 SPY 10%

theses.subject: BIL
theses.thesis: The engineered low-real-yield regime explicitly favors front-end Treasuries: Bessent runs bill-heavy issuance and buybacks, while the Fed keeps reinvesting MBS runoff into T-bills through 2026. Against a hawkish Fed and unclear labor data, BIL captures the carry and the structural T-bill bid without taking duration or equity risk relative to SPY.
theses.thesis_zh: 被刻意维持的低实际利率格局明确利好前端美债：贝森特以短债为主的发行和回购运行，而美联储在2026年内持续把 MBS 到期回笼再投资于短债。在美联储鹰派、就业数据不明朗的背景下，BIL 能吃到票息和结构性短债买盘，而不必承担久期或相对 SPY 的股票风险。
evidence: Theater: Dollar/debt — reinforces front-end Treasuries; stablecoin issuers/rails a structural T-bill bid
Open prediction: Fed keeps reinvesting MBS runoff into T-bills through 2026
Rotation theme: Front-end Treasuries — proxies BIL, SHV
Thesis: bill-heavy issuance, buybacks, dealer-intermediation reform
theses.dissent: In a reflation quad with a clear market driver, SPY can simply out-carry the front end; BIL is a defensive stance that gives up the capital-rotation upside.
theses.dissent_zh: 在再通胀象限、市场主线清晰的情况下，SPY 可以简单地跑赢前端的票息；BIL 是防御性立场，会放弃资本轮动的上行空间。
